scientific_integrity: Proof is a geometric normal-bundle argument plus exactly checkable polynomial and finite-field computations. Fifteen and twelve Clebsch lines and the standard twenty-seven-line theorem are recognized as prior knowledge.
scientific_limitations: The statement is specific to the coefficient-marked model V(e_1,e_3) over the integers, not to the characteristic-two modular Segre model. The separate good modular cubic retains ten nodes. The result does not classify all models or semistable reductions. Independent verification has not occurred.
title: The symmetric Segre model has a length-sixteen dyadic vertex and twenty-seven reduced Fano planes
